title: You Cannot Keep It
setup: Black took the Catalan pawn and has just propped it up with ...b5. Hit that pawn chain before it settles.
hint: Black is holding the extra pawn with a chain. Ask which of your pawns can reach the bottom of it, and what opens behind.
explanation:
## The Idea

The Catalan lends a pawn. Holding on to it costs Black the queenside.

{{a4}} hits the chain at its base. If Black props it up with {{c6}}, then {{axb5}} {{cxb5}} takes the c-pawn off the long diagonal, and {{Ne5}} clears the rest of it: the bishop on g2 looks straight at the rook on a8, and the knight eyes c4.

Black must cover a8, usually with {{Nd5}}, and b5 has no defender.

A pawn you must defend with more pawns is a pawn you are paying for.
